sources.entry: JoeBro - Native AI workspace with a local Python backend. Chat, documents, memory, MCP tools and deep research, using local models or any API.

summary.one_liner: JoeBro is a native macOS SwiftUI AI workspace with a bundled, dependency-free Python backend that offers chat, agent tools, documents, long-term memory, email, calendar, and deep research using local models or any API key.
summary.what_it_does: JoeBro is a native macOS app (SwiftUI) with a Python standard-library backend bundled inside and launched automatically, talking to the app over localhost. It provides chat with any model (streaming, extended thinking, folders) and an agent mode that can read and edit files, run the terminal, search the web, call custom API tools, and manage email and calendar. Deep Research reads many sources and writes a cited report, and documents (including .doc/.docx) can be edited beside the conversation. A "Brain" long-term memory stores topic-filed facts with an interactive graph view, and skills are learned from usage or from example folders. It also includes Anki .apkg flashcard generation, an AI-text checker, MCP server support over stdio, plugins, a Telegram Message Bot orchestrator, and an optional iPhone pairing feature that requires a separately built companion app.
use_cases: chat with local or API-hosted AI models on a Mac
agent that edits documents and files on your machine
long-term personal memory for an AI assistant
managing email and calendar through an AI assistant
generating Anki flashcard decks from study material
controlling an AI workspace remotely via Telegram
how_to_run: Open JoeBro.xcodeproj in Xcode 26 or later.
Select the JoeBro scheme and the My Mac destination.
Press Run; the bundled Python backend launches with the app.
Open Settings and add a model endpoint (local Ollama or an API key).
Optionally connect an IMAP mailbox and calendar.
Alternatively, download JoeBro.dmg from Releases and open it via right-click > Open the first time.
notable: Zero external Python dependencies; backend is stdlib only and bundled inside the app, with no Electron
Cloak Mode swaps API keys, passwords, emails and card/account numbers for placeholders before any request leaves the backend
Brain memory stores one fact per entry on topic pages and renders an interactive brain map graph
Stateless MCP client that spawns, calls, and kills servers with hard timeouts
Telegram Message Bot can drive chats and delegate work from a phone
caveats: Requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later on Apple Silicon and Xcode 26 to build
The app is not notarized by Apple, so first launch requires a Gatekeeper workaround
The iPhone phone feature only works while JoeBro is open and the Mac is awake, and needs the separate JoeBro Mobile repo
keywords: run ai on my own computer
